capabilities: Save URLs from Obsidian notes to your Instapaper account
Sync highlights and notes from Instapaper into the vault
Customize synced note properties and a Mustache highlight template
Normalize Instapaper tags to valid Obsidian tag syntax
Link to specific highlights using block identifiers
extras: Official Instapaper plugin; README notes it was a 2024 Obsidian Gem of the Year, requires Obsidian v1.11.0 or higher, and directs feedback to support@help.instapaper.com.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull saved articles, highlights, and notes from an Instapaper account into the vault.

relations.evidence: It integrates with your Instapaper account

summary: Official Instapaster integration that saves URLs from notes to Instapaper and syncs your Instapaper highlights and notes into your vault.
